title: PHORECAST: Enabling AI Understanding of Public Health Outreach Across Populations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model prediction accuracy and Semantic Text Similarity (STS) of generated responses across different age groups (e.g., 18-24, 25-34, 65+).
Calculating and comparing model response prediction accuracy and semantic text similarity across male, female, and non-binary demographic groups.
Evaluating model performance and accuracy disparities when predicting responses for individuals across various religious affiliations (e.g., Christianity, Islam, Judaism, Agnostic).
Assessing the model's ability to emulate human responses by comparing prediction accuracy and semantic text similarity across different racial and ethnic groups (e.g., White, Black, Hispanic, Asian).
Measuring the impact of educational attainment on prediction accuracy through feature ablation and analyzing response distribution variations across different education levels.
Analyzing model prediction patterns and baseline opinion shifts across individuals with different political affiliations (e.g., Conservative, Liberal, Libertarian, Independent).

Evaluating performance disparities in opinion prediction across different Big Five personality traits and locus of control profiles using Statistical Distribution of Embeddings (SDE) and accuracy metrics.
